name: Fir and juniper
desc: Conifers of the subalpine forest, which Wikipedia says holds fir, birch and rhododendron above about 3,000 m.
about: Abies spectabilis, the East Himalayan fir, is a conifer species in the family Pinaceae and the genus Abies. It is sometimes held to include the Bhutan fir (A. densa) as a variety.
